_notes.name: The name engraved on the panel and shown on the lock screen.
_notes.theme: walnut (oiled walnut and brass; cream glass by day, amber by night), bakelite (ivory and chrome by day, oxblood by night), or black-steel (brushed black steel, dark only).
_notes.presets: The stations on the dial, left to right. Each needs a name and a url that starts with https://, the station's own stream. homepage, country, and about are optional; about is the line under the station name. logo is optional: an https address, or a picture file in the project folder that run.py copies beside the page.
_notes.finding streams: For a country or a genre the person names, ask https://de1.api.radio-browser.info/json/stations/search?tag=jazz&hidebroken=true&order=votes&reverse=true&limit=10 (or country=Japan) and take url_resolved from rows whose url_resolved starts with https://.
